scenarios.name: contact-activity
scenarios.about: CORE131: contacts created by capture carry last_contacted_at and last_interacted_at. The connection wrote to jane (cc bob) at 07:20, so both are contacted then; bob also reacted at 07:30; carol only wrote (interacted, never contacted); owner is a contact here because the messaging seed has no own identity. The six filters partition them; an unparseable time and sort are validation errors; the golden actors hold interactions:read in messaging scenarios, so the keys are present
